exposure.needed: whether bugtool is invoked with --k8s-mode, --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace or --k8s-label in scripts or tooling

consequence.statement: The flags still work in 1.17 but will be removed in Cilium 1.18, so usage must move to the Cilium CLI for sysdump collection.
consequence.remediation: Use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

assertion.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (and related --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace, --k8s-label) is deprecated and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.
